cases.title: Emergency: Ayaan needs referral
cases.name: Ayaan - full emergency example (fictional)
cases.story: Cough for 4 days. Fever for 2 days. No vomiting. No diarrhoea. No wheeze. He is drinking normally. His caregiver says he is breathing faster today.

answers.chief_complaint: Cough and fever; caregiver reports faster breathing today.
answers.symptom_onset: Cough started 4 days ago; fever started 2 days ago.
answers.worker_request: Please review the child's breathing and measurements, and advise whether urgent referral is needed.

cases.advice: FICTIONAL ROLE-PLAY: The newly returned oxygen reading is 89%. Arrange urgent transfer to the selected referral facility now; do not delay transfer to finish paperwork or give a routine medicine demonstration. Follow the local emergency protocol and contact the receiving clinical team.

cases.return_if: This is already the emergency pathway: proceed with the urgent referral. Report any further worsening immediately to the receiving care team.
cases.counselling: Explain that the oxygen reading has worsened and urgent assessment is needed. Ask the caregiver to repeat the destination and immediate next action. Tell them the on-screen pre-alert is simulated in this demonstration.
